wording: In a two-deme linkage toy (N = 200, 400 generations), neutral Fst fell with recombination distance from a divergently selected locus: 0.52, 0.51, 0.34, 0.17, 0.07 for c = 0, 0.001, 0.01, 0.05, 0.5 (s = 0.1, m = 0.01). confidence: Moderate (60 replicates x 8 loci per distance; toy)
counterevidence_limits: Haploid star-linkage toy; c is a per-generation recombination probability, not Heliconius cM; random starting frequencies, no secondary contact.
operationalization: Divergence = island of differentiation around a selected locus

wording: Doubling deme size (N = 200, Nm = 2) reproduced the DVA dose-response at an unlinked selected locus (Fst 0.03 to 0.68 from s = 0 to 0.1, neutral about 0.03); the island criterion was again met only at s = 0.1 (0.455 at s = 0.05).

counterevidence_limits: Normal-form toy; P10 provides only the metaphor.
operationalization: Divergence = bifurcation sensitivity to small asymmetries
